name: Organic Deconstruction
blurb: Innate:  Vel'Koz's  abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction to enemies hit for a few seconds.

effects.description: Innate: Vel'Koz's abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction to enemies hit for 7 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
The third stack consumes them all to deal 35 - 180 (based on level) (+ 60% AP) bonus true damage.
